title: FFmpeg Media
concept: FFmpeg bindings for XIOM — process video and audio: decode, encode, transcode, filter, and stream media files in any format.
why: FFmpeg is the universal media toolkit — it powers VLC, YouTube, and OBS. From video editing to streaming, FFmpeg handles all media processing needs.
tips: FFmpeg is CPU-intensive — use hardware acceleration when available (h264_amf, h264_nvenc)
Probing is fast and doesn't decode — use it to check file metadata before full processing
Filter order matters — scale before adding text ensures consistent text size
Always check input codec support before transcoding — some codecs require separate installation
common_mistakes: Not specifying output format — FFmpeg guesses from extension, sometimes incorrectly
Forgetting audio when creating video output — explicitly add .no_audio() or .audio_codec()
Setting bitrate without considering codec efficiency — VP9 needs less bitrate than H264 for same quality
